description: Returns the durable evidence records for a commitment (stable identifiers, integrity references, submitter attribution, status, timestamps � never raw payload content). The caller must present an EIP-712 authority proof and hold an active authorization on the commitment. Commitment-scoped: callers with no authorization on the commitment see nothing. Optional status filter (submitted|verified|rejected|disputed). Read-only.

commitmentId.description: The commitment ID whose evidence to list
